Oneliner

Constellation for collecting AIS and ADS-B messages.
Description

Monitoring the locations of aircraft and vessels in an area from 37 deg North to 37 deg South using ADS-B and AIS signals. Own and operate a constellation of nanosatellites to be launched into a low-inclination Equatorial orbit.
